annotation.speech2: A polar grid with two gray circles of radii one half and one. Two petal shaped loops: a blue loop above the x axis, the branch r equals the square root of sine theta, and a vermillion loop below the x axis, the branch r equals negative the square root of sine theta. Together they form a graph symmetric about the origin.
The branch r equals the positive square root of sine theta, a loop above the x axis.
The branch r equals the negative square root of sine theta, a loop below the x axis, the reflection of the blue loop through the origin.
